0022600204.text: The Hornets (3-7) are at home, on a six-game losing streak, and sit 11th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, three games back, while the Cavaliers (5-4) carry a one-game winning streak and are 5th in the East and 1.5 games back in the Central. Charlotte is without Dennis Schroder (thigh), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring strain), and Moussa Diabate (quadriceps), and Brandon Miller is day-to-day with groin soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Hornets lost the season series 1-3, including a 118-113 loss in Charlotte on February 20, 2026.
